verdict.rationale: Raygun docs confirm native repo integrations (GitHub, Bitbucket, GitLab) with source map decoding, which supports resolving stack traces to source, but there is no evidence of suspect-commit identification, code owner attribution, or a documented 'jump to line on default branch' deep-link feature. missing for 10: suspect commit/blame detection, code owner surfacing, direct stack-frame-to-repo-line navigation evidence, independent confirmation of these workflow features.
